headline:
Before The First Freeze
A Look At Outdoor Faucets
titan_line: Echo, the University of Georgia (UGA) Cooperative Extension has a few notes on outdoor pipes and hoses before freezing weather.
rows: Water freezing inside an outdoor pipe can split it, and that means a call to a plumber.
Hoses just unscrew from the faucet, so no professional is needed for that one.
Exposed pipes and valves can be wrapped. A plumber can help with the hard-to-reach ones.
echo_line: Mine has been on the spigot since August. Slippers on, walking out there now.
source: University of Georgia Cooperative Extension, winterizing outdoor pipes · seen October 30, 2026
disclaimer: General home information, not an inspection or advice about any home. Ask a licensed plumber about yours.
